caption: Opening of "Cap. XIIII, De la yerva que llaman Ololiuhqui," from the 1615 Ximénez abridgment of Hernández's Quatro libros.
alt: Page of small-format 17th-century Spanish black-letter-style print, with the heading CAP.XIIII.DE LA YERVA QVE LLAMAN OLOLIVHQVI partway down the page, followed by the chapter's opening lines.
credit: Internet Archive / Casa de la viuda de Diego López Dávalos (Mexico, 1615)
note: This is the actual leaf (n171 of the scan) where Book 2, chapter 14 begins, matching the excerpted passage in the draft ("Es la ololiuhqui, q otros llama cohuaxihuitl..."). Found by parsing the item's djvu.xml for the OCR text of chapter 13 (Mecaxuchitl) running into chapter 14 (Ololiuhqui); no printed folio number is visible on this leaf, but it is bracketed by numbered pages 77 and 78 in the same gathering.
